description:
Vital Recorder is open on the Windows desktop. Three real intraoperative vital signs recordings from the VitalDB open dataset are available in C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\VitalRecorderData\: 0001.vital, 0002.vital, and 0003.vital.

The pharmacy and therapeutics committee is conducting a retrospective audit of volatile anesthetic agent usage. They require a complete inventory of which surgical case recordings include sevoflurane concentration monitoring — specifically, cases with both inspired (INSP_SEVO) and expired (EXP_SEVO) sevoflurane channels.

You must:
1. Open and inspect each of the three recordings to determine which contain sevoflurane monitoring data.
2. For each case that includes both INSP_SEVO and EXP_SEVO tracks: export the full vital signs dataset to a CSV file on the Desktop, naming each file case_XXXX_sevo.csv (replace XXXX with the actual case number, e.g., case_0001_sevo.csv).
3. Produce a written anesthetic inventory report saved as C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\anesthetic_inventory.txt that documents: (a) which cases contain sevoflurane monitoring and which do not, (b) the track names available in each case you reviewed, (c) the recording duration of each case, and (d) a brief note on the clinical significance of monitoring both inspired and expired sevoflurane concentrations.

Do not guess or assume — you must open each file in Vital Recorder to examine its track list before making your determination.

Login: Windows Desktop user (no Vital Recorder login required). Vital data files are in C:\Users\Docker\Desktop\VitalRecorderData\.
